plain: A new hds-token-keys codemod rewrites the deprecated hds.density steps to their hds.semantic.space.scale twins, so the upgrade command moves them for you.

steps.plain: hds.density is deprecated; the upgrade command rewrites hds.density.sm to hds.semantic.space.scale.xs (md to sm, lg to md, xl to lg, xl2 to xl), the same pixels. density.xs, xl3 and xl4 have no scale step: use hds.space.px4, px64 or px80, which do not shrink under compact density.
